meaning.en: to do, to drive, to set in motion (actus: a thing done)
meaning.tr: yapmak, yürütmek, harekete geçirmek (actus: yapılan şey)
meaning.de: tun, treiben, in Bewegung setzen (actus: das Getane)
meaning.fr: faire, mener, mettre en mouvement (actus : ce qui est fait)
meaning.it: fare, condurre, mettere in moto (actus: ciò che è fatto)
meaning.es: hacer, conducir, poner en marcha (actus: lo hecho)

gloss.en: to do something, to behave; to play a part in a film or play; also a noun: a thing done
gloss.tr: davranmak, harekete geçmek; rol yapmak; (isim) eylem, davranış
gloss.de: handeln, sich verhalten; schauspielern; (Nomen) die Tat, der Akt
gloss.fr: agir, se comporter ; jouer (un rôle) ; (nom) l'acte
gloss.it: agire, comportarsi; recitare; (nome) l'atto, il gesto

sentences.en: We must [act] quickly to save the forest.
sentences.tr: Ormanı kurtarmak için hızlı davranmalıyız.
sentences.de: Wir müssen schnell handeln, um den Wald zu retten.
sentences.fr: Nous devons agir vite pour sauver la forêt.
sentences.it: Dobbiamo agire in fretta per salvare la foresta.
sentences.es: Debemos actuar rápido para salvar el bosque.

sentences.en: She has [acted] in three films.
sentences.tr: Üç filmde oynadı.
sentences.de: Sie hat in drei Filmen gespielt.
sentences.fr: Elle a joué dans trois films.
sentences.it: Ha recitato in tre film.
sentences.es: Ha actuado en tres películas.

sentences.en: Helping him was an [act] of kindness.
sentences.tr: Ona yardım etmek bir iyilik örneğiydi.
sentences.de: Ihm zu helfen war ein Akt der Freundlichkeit.
sentences.fr: L'aider était un acte de gentillesse.
sentences.it: Aiutarlo è stato un gesto di gentilezza.
sentences.es: Ayudarlo fue un acto de bondad.

gloss.en: something done; the process of doing something
gloss.de: die Handlung, die Tat, das Handeln

sentences.en: It's time to take [action] on climate change.
sentences.tr: İklim değişikliğine karşı harekete geçme zamanı.
sentences.de: Es ist Zeit, gegen den Klimawandel zu handeln.
sentences.fr: Il est temps d'agir contre le changement climatique.
sentences.it: È ora di agire contro il cambiamento climatico.
sentences.es: Es hora de actuar contra el cambio climático.

sentences.en: My brother loves [action] films with car chases.
sentences.tr: Kardeşim araba kovalamacalı aksiyon filmlerine bayılır.
sentences.de: Mein Bruder liebt Actionfilme mit Verfolgungsjagden.
sentences.fr: Mon frère adore les films d'action avec des courses-poursuites.
sentences.it: Mio fratello adora i film d'azione con gli inseguimenti in auto.
sentences.es: A mi hermano le encantan las películas de acción con persecuciones.

gloss.en: a person who plays a part in films, plays or TV

sentences.en: My favourite [actor] won an award last night.
sentences.tr: En sevdiğim oyuncu dün gece bir ödül kazandı.
sentences.de: Mein Lieblingsschauspieler hat gestern Abend einen Preis gewonnen.
sentences.fr: Mon acteur préféré a gagné un prix hier soir.
sentences.it: Il mio attore preferito ha vinto un premio ieri sera.
sentences.es: Mi actor favorito ganó un premio anoche.

sentences.en: The [actors] bowed at the end of the play.
sentences.tr: Oyuncular oyunun sonunda eğilerek selam verdi.
sentences.de: Die Schauspieler verbeugten sich am Ende des Stücks.
sentences.fr: Les acteurs ont salué à la fin de la pièce.
sentences.it: Gli attori si sono inchinati alla fine dello spettacolo.
sentences.es: Los actores saludaron al final de la obra.

gloss.en: real, true; not imagined or estimated (careful: it does not mean 'current')

sentences.en: The [actual] price was higher than we expected.
sentences.tr: Gerçek fiyat beklediğimizden yüksekti.
sentences.de: Der tatsächliche Preis war höher als erwartet.
sentences.fr: Le prix réel était plus élevé que prévu.
sentences.it: Il prezzo effettivo era più alto del previsto.
sentences.es: El precio real era más alto de lo que esperábamos.

sentences.en: He looks older than his [actual] age.
sentences.tr: Gerçek yaşından daha yaşlı görünüyor.
sentences.de: Er sieht älter aus, als er tatsächlich ist.
sentences.fr: Il fait plus vieux que son âge réel.
sentences.it: Sembra più vecchio della sua età reale.
sentences.es: Parece mayor de lo que es en realidad.

gloss.en: in fact, really; used to correct something or add a surprise (careful: it does not mean 'currently')

sentences.en: I thought he was French, but he's [actually] Belgian.
sentences.tr: Fransız olduğunu sanıyordum ama aslında Belçikalı.
sentences.de: Ich dachte, er sei Franzose, aber eigentlich ist er Belgier.
sentences.fr: Je pensais qu'il était français, mais en fait il est belge.
sentences.it: Pensavo fosse francese, ma in realtà è belga.
sentences.es: Pensaba que era francés, pero en realidad es belga.

sentences.en: Did you [actually] read the whole book?
sentences.tr: Kitabın tamamını gerçekten okudun mu?
sentences.de: Hast du wirklich das ganze Buch gelesen?
sentences.fr: Tu as vraiment lu tout le livre ?
sentences.it: Hai davvero letto tutto il libro?
sentences.es: ¿De verdad leíste el libro entero?

gloss.en: busy doing things, moving a lot; working, not stopped

sentences.en: My grandmother is still very [active] at 85.
sentences.tr: Büyükannem 85 yaşında hâlâ çok hareketli.
sentences.de: Meine Großmutter ist mit 85 noch sehr aktiv.
sentences.fr: Ma grand-mère est encore très active à 85 ans.
sentences.it: Mia nonna è ancora molto attiva a 85 anni.
sentences.es: Mi abuela sigue muy activa a los 85 años.

sentences.en: This volcano is still [active].
sentences.tr: Bu yanardağ hâlâ etkin.
sentences.de: Dieser Vulkan ist noch aktiv.
sentences.fr: Ce volcan est toujours actif.
sentences.it: Questo vulcano è ancora attivo.
sentences.es: Este volcán sigue activo.

gloss.en: by doing something, not just waiting or watching

sentences.en: She is [actively] looking for a new job.
sentences.tr: Aktif olarak yeni bir iş arıyor.
sentences.de: Sie sucht aktiv nach einer neuen Stelle.
sentences.fr: Elle cherche activement un nouvel emploi.
sentences.it: Sta cercando attivamente un nuovo lavoro.
sentences.es: Está buscando activamente un nuevo trabajo.

sentences.en: The students took part [actively] in the discussion.
sentences.tr: Öğrenciler tartışmaya etkin biçimde katıldı.
sentences.de: Die Schüler beteiligten sich aktiv an der Diskussion.
sentences.fr: Les élèves ont participé activement à la discussion.
sentences.it: Gli studenti hanno partecipato attivamente alla discussione.
sentences.es: Los alumnos participaron activamente en el debate.

gloss.en: not moving or doing much; not working or in use

sentences.en: Many children are too [inactive] these days.
sentences.tr: Bugünlerde pek çok çocuk fazla hareketsiz.
sentences.de: Viele Kinder bewegen sich heutzutage zu wenig.
sentences.fr: Beaucoup d'enfants sont trop inactifs aujourd'hui.
sentences.it: Oggi molti bambini sono troppo sedentari.
sentences.es: Hoy en día muchos niños son demasiado inactivos.

sentences.en: Your account was closed because it was [inactive].
sentences.tr: Hesabınız kullanılmadığı için kapatıldı.
sentences.de: Ihr Konto wurde geschlossen, weil es inaktiv war.
sentences.fr: Votre compte a été fermé car il était inactif.
sentences.it: Il suo account è stato chiuso perché era inattivo.
sentences.es: Su cuenta se cerró porque estaba inactiva.

gloss.en: acting early to stop problems, not waiting for them to happen

sentences.en: Be [proactive] and fix small problems early.
sentences.tr: Önceden harekete geç ve küçük sorunları erkenden çöz.
sentences.de: Sei vorausschauend und behebe kleine Probleme früh.
sentences.fr: Sois proactif et règle les petits problèmes tôt.
sentences.it: Sii proattivo e risolvi presto i piccoli problemi.
sentences.es: Sé proactivo y resuelve pronto los pequeños problemas.

sentences.en: The school takes a [proactive] approach to bullying.
sentences.tr: Okul zorbalığa karşı önleyici bir yaklaşım benimsiyor.
sentences.de: Die Schule geht vorbeugend gegen Mobbing vor.
sentences.fr: L'école adopte une approche proactive face au harcèlement.
sentences.it: La scuola adotta un approccio proattivo contro il bullismo.
sentences.es: La escuela adopta un enfoque proactivo contra el acoso.

gloss.en: something you do for fun or to learn; a situation where a lot is happening

sentences.en: Swimming is my favourite summer [activity].
sentences.tr: Yüzmek en sevdiğim yaz etkinliği.
sentences.de: Schwimmen ist meine liebste Sommeraktivität.
sentences.fr: La natation est mon activité d'été préférée.
sentences.it: Il nuoto è la mia attività estiva preferita.
sentences.es: Nadar es mi actividad de verano favorita.

sentences.en: There was a lot of [activity] at the station.
sentences.tr: İstasyonda büyük bir hareketlilik vardı.
sentences.de: Am Bahnhof herrschte viel Betrieb.
sentences.fr: Il y avait beaucoup d'animation à la gare.
sentences.it: C'era molto movimento alla stazione.
sentences.es: Había mucho movimiento en la estación.

gloss.en: to make something start working

sentences.en: You need to [activate] your new card before using it.
sentences.tr: Yeni kartınızı kullanmadan önce etkinleştirmeniz gerekiyor.
sentences.de: Sie müssen Ihre neue Karte vor der Nutzung aktivieren.
sentences.fr: Vous devez activer votre nouvelle carte avant de l'utiliser.
sentences.it: Deve attivare la nuova carta prima di usarla.
sentences.es: Tiene que activar su nueva tarjeta antes de usarla.

sentences.en: Smoke [activated] the fire alarm.
sentences.tr: Duman yangın alarmını çalıştırdı.
sentences.de: Rauch löste den Feueralarm aus.
sentences.fr: La fumée a déclenché l'alarme incendie.
sentences.it: Il fumo ha fatto scattare l'allarme antincendio.
sentences.es: El humo activó la alarma de incendios.

gloss.en: a person who works hard for political or social change

sentences.en: She became an environmental [activist] at sixteen.
sentences.tr: On altı yaşında çevre aktivisti oldu.
sentences.de: Mit sechzehn wurde sie Umweltaktivistin.
sentences.fr: Elle est devenue militante écologiste à seize ans.
sentences.it: È diventata un'attivista ambientale a sedici anni.
sentences.es: Se hizo activista medioambiental a los dieciséis años.

sentences.en: [Activists] protested outside the factory.
sentences.tr: Aktivistler fabrikanın önünde protesto yaptı.
sentences.de: Aktivisten protestierten vor der Fabrik.
sentences.fr: Des militants ont manifesté devant l'usine.
sentences.it: Gli attivisti hanno protestato davanti alla fabbrica.
sentences.es: Los activistas protestaron frente a la fábrica.

gloss.en: to do or say something because of what has happened (literally: to act back)

sentences.en: How did your parents [react] to the news?
sentences.tr: Ailen habere nasıl tepki verdi?
sentences.de: Wie haben deine Eltern auf die Nachricht reagiert?
sentences.fr: Comment tes parents ont-ils réagi à la nouvelle ?
sentences.it: Come hanno reagito i tuoi genitori alla notizia?
sentences.es: ¿Cómo reaccionaron tus padres a la noticia?

sentences.en: The driver [reacted] fast and stopped the car.
sentences.tr: Sürücü hızlı tepki verdi ve arabayı durdurdu.
sentences.de: Der Fahrer reagierte schnell und hielt das Auto an.
sentences.fr: Le conducteur a réagi vite et a arrêté la voiture.
sentences.it: L'autista ha reagito in fretta e ha fermato l'auto.
sentences.es: El conductor reaccionó rápido y detuvo el coche.

gloss.en: what you do, say or feel because of something

sentences.en: His first [reaction] was to laugh.
sentences.tr: İlk tepkisi gülmek oldu.
sentences.de: Seine erste Reaktion war, zu lachen.
sentences.fr: Sa première réaction a été de rire.
sentences.it: La sua prima reazione è stata ridere.
sentences.es: Su primera reacción fue reírse.

sentences.en: She had an allergic [reaction] to the nuts.
sentences.tr: Kuruyemişe alerjik tepki verdi.
sentences.de: Sie hatte eine allergische Reaktion auf die Nüsse.
sentences.fr: Elle a fait une réaction allergique aux fruits à coque.
sentences.it: Ha avuto una reazione allergica alla frutta secca.
sentences.es: Tuvo una reacción alérgica a los frutos secos.

gloss.en: to talk or work with others; to affect each other (literally: to act between)

sentences.en: Children learn by [interacting] with each other.
sentences.tr: Çocuklar birbirleriyle etkileşim kurarak öğrenir.
sentences.de: Kinder lernen, indem sie miteinander umgehen.
sentences.fr: Les enfants apprennent en interagissant les uns avec les autres.
sentences.it: I bambini imparano interagendo tra loro.
sentences.es: Los niños aprenden interactuando entre ellos.

sentences.en: Some medicines [interact] badly with alcohol.
sentences.tr: Bazı ilaçlar alkolle kötü etkileşime girer.
sentences.de: Manche Medikamente vertragen sich schlecht mit Alkohol.
sentences.fr: Certains médicaments interagissent mal avec l'alcool.
sentences.it: Alcuni farmaci interagiscono male con l'alcol.
sentences.es: Algunos medicamentos interactúan mal con el alcohol.

gloss.en: the way people or things talk to, work with or affect each other

sentences.en: The game encourages [interaction] between players.
sentences.tr: Oyun oyuncular arasındaki etkileşimi teşvik ediyor.
sentences.de: Das Spiel fördert die Interaktion zwischen den Spielern.
sentences.fr: Le jeu encourage l'interaction entre les joueurs.
sentences.it: Il gioco favorisce l'interazione tra i giocatori.
sentences.es: El juego fomenta la interacción entre los jugadores.

sentences.en: Online lessons have less [interaction] than classroom lessons.
sentences.tr: Çevrimiçi derslerde yüz yüze derslere göre daha az etkileşim var.
sentences.de: Online-Unterricht bietet weniger Interaktion als Präsenzunterricht.
sentences.fr: Les cours en ligne offrent moins d'interaction que les cours en classe.
sentences.it: Le lezioni online hanno meno interazione di quelle in classe.
sentences.es: Las clases en línea tienen menos interacción que las presenciales.

gloss.en: letting you take part or respond, not just watch

sentences.en: The museum has an [interactive] map for kids.
sentences.tr: Müzede çocuklar için etkileşimli bir harita var.
sentences.de: Das Museum hat eine interaktive Karte für Kinder.
sentences.fr: Le musée a une carte interactive pour les enfants.
sentences.it: Il museo ha una mappa interattiva per bambini.
sentences.es: El museo tiene un mapa interactivo para niños.

sentences.en: Our teacher makes the lessons very [interactive].
sentences.tr: Öğretmenimiz dersleri çok etkileşimli hale getiriyor.
sentences.de: Unsere Lehrerin gestaltet den Unterricht sehr interaktiv.
sentences.fr: Notre professeure rend les cours très interactifs.
sentences.it: La nostra insegnante rende le lezioni molto interattive.
sentences.es: Nuestra profesora hace las clases muy interactivas.

gloss.en: to make a plan into law; to act out a scene (literally: to put into action)

sentences.en: The government [enacted] a new law on plastic bags.
sentences.tr: Hükümet plastik poşetlerle ilgili yeni bir yasa çıkardı.
sentences.de: Die Regierung erließ ein neues Gesetz über Plastiktüten.
sentences.fr: Le gouvernement a adopté une nouvelle loi sur les sacs plastiques.
sentences.it: Il governo ha emanato una nuova legge sui sacchetti di plastica.
sentences.es: El gobierno promulgó una nueva ley sobre las bolsas de plástico.

sentences.en: The students [enacted] a famous scene from history.
sentences.tr: Öğrenciler tarihten ünlü bir sahneyi canlandırdı.
sentences.de: Die Schüler stellten eine berühmte Szene aus der Geschichte nach.
sentences.fr: Les élèves ont joué une scène célèbre de l'histoire.
sentences.it: Gli studenti hanno messo in scena un famoso episodio della storia.
sentences.es: Los alumnos representaron una escena famosa de la historia.

gloss.en: completely correct, with nothing more or less (from Latin exactus, 'weighed out, made precise', of exigere)

sentences.en: What is the [exact] time, please?
sentences.tr: Saat tam olarak kaç, lütfen?
sentences.de: Wie spät ist es genau, bitte?
sentences.fr: Quelle est l'heure exacte, s'il vous plaît ?
sentences.it: Qual è l'ora esatta, per favore?
sentences.es: ¿Qué hora es exactamente, por favor?

sentences.en: I can't remember his [exact] words.
sentences.tr: Onun tam olarak ne dediğini hatırlayamıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich erinnere mich nicht an seine genauen Worte.
sentences.fr: Je ne me souviens pas de ses mots exacts.
sentences.it: Non ricordo le sue parole esatte.
sentences.es: No recuerdo sus palabras exactas.

gloss.en: completely, precisely; also said to agree: 'yes, that's right'

sentences.en: The train left at [exactly] six o'clock.
sentences.tr: Tren saat tam altıda kalktı.
sentences.de: Der Zug fuhr um genau sechs Uhr ab.
sentences.fr: Le train est parti à six heures exactement.
sentences.it: Il treno è partito esattamente alle sei.
sentences.es: El tren salió exactamente a las seis.

sentences.en: That's [exactly] what I wanted to say.
sentences.tr: Tam da söylemek istediğim buydu.
sentences.de: Das ist genau das, was ich sagen wollte.
sentences.fr: C'est exactement ce que je voulais dire.
sentences.it: È esattamente quello che volevo dire.
sentences.es: Eso es exactamente lo que quería decir.

gloss.en: an act of buying, selling or moving money (from Latin transigere, 'to drive through, to settle')

sentences.en: Every [transaction] appears on your bank statement.
sentences.tr: Her işlem banka hesap özetinizde görünür.
sentences.de: Jede Transaktion erscheint auf Ihrem Kontoauszug.
sentences.fr: Chaque transaction apparaît sur votre relevé bancaire.
sentences.it: Ogni transazione compare sul suo estratto conto.
sentences.es: Cada transacción aparece en su extracto bancario.

sentences.en: The shop charges a small fee per [transaction].
sentences.tr: Mağaza her işlem için küçük bir ücret alıyor.
sentences.de: Der Laden verlangt eine kleine Gebühr pro Transaktion.
sentences.fr: Le magasin facture de petits frais par transaction.
sentences.it: Il negozio applica una piccola commissione per ogni transazione.
sentences.es: La tienda cobra una pequeña comisión por transacción.

gloss.en: a person who acts or does business for someone else; a spy (literally: one who does)
gloss.de: der Vertreter, der Makler; der Agent

sentences.en: Our travel [agent] booked the hotel for us.
sentences.tr: Seyahat acentemiz otel rezervasyonumuzu yaptı.
sentences.de: Unser Reisebüro hat das Hotel für uns gebucht.
sentences.fr: Notre agent de voyages nous a réservé l'hôtel.
sentences.it: Il nostro agente di viaggio ci ha prenotato l'albergo.
sentences.es: Nuestro agente de viajes nos reservó el hotel.

sentences.en: The film is about a secret [agent] in Berlin.
sentences.tr: Film Berlin'deki bir gizli ajanı anlatıyor.
sentences.de: Der Film handelt von einem Geheimagenten in Berlin.
sentences.fr: Le film parle d'un agent secret à Berlin.
sentences.it: Il film parla di un agente segreto a Berlino.
sentences.es: La película trata de un agente secreto en Berlín.

gloss.en: a business or organization that does work for others

sentences.en: She works for an advertising [agency].
sentences.tr: Bir reklam ajansında çalışıyor.
sentences.de: Sie arbeitet für eine Werbeagentur.
sentences.fr: Elle travaille pour une agence de publicité.
sentences.it: Lavora per un'agenzia pubblicitaria.
sentences.es: Trabaja para una agencia de publicidad.

sentences.en: We found our flat through an [agency].
sentences.tr: Dairemizi bir emlak bürosu aracılığıyla bulduk.
sentences.de: Wir haben unsere Wohnung über eine Agentur gefunden.
sentences.fr: Nous avons trouvé notre appartement par une agence.
sentences.it: Abbiamo trovato l'appartamento tramite un'agenzia.
sentences.es: Encontramos nuestro piso a través de una agencia.

gloss.en: able to move quickly and easily; quick at thinking (literally: easy to set in motion)

sentences.en: Cats are very [agile] animals.
sentences.tr: Kediler çok çevik hayvanlardır.
sentences.de: Katzen sind sehr wendige Tiere.
sentences.fr: Les chats sont des animaux très agiles.
sentences.it: I gatti sono animali molto agili.
sentences.es: Los gatos son animales muy ágiles.

sentences.en: At ninety, he still has an [agile] mind.
sentences.tr: Doksan yaşında zihni hâlâ çok çevik.
sentences.de: Mit neunzig ist er geistig noch sehr beweglich.
sentences.fr: À quatre-vingt-dix ans, il a encore l'esprit vif.
sentences.it: A novant'anni ha ancora una mente agile.
sentences.es: A los noventa años, todavía tiene una mente ágil.

gloss.en: the ability to move quickly and easily

sentences.en: Football players need speed and [agility].
sentences.tr: Futbolcuların hıza ve çevikliğe ihtiyacı vardır.
sentences.de: Fußballspieler brauchen Schnelligkeit und Wendigkeit.
sentences.fr: Les footballeurs ont besoin de vitesse et d'agilité.
sentences.it: I calciatori hanno bisogno di velocità e agilità.
sentences.es: Los futbolistas necesitan velocidad y agilidad.

sentences.en: The monkey climbed the tree with great [agility].
sentences.tr: Maymun ağaca büyük bir çeviklikle tırmandı.
sentences.de: Der Affe kletterte sehr geschickt auf den Baum.
sentences.fr: Le singe a grimpé à l'arbre avec une grande agilité.
sentences.it: La scimmia si è arrampicata sull'albero con grande agilità.
sentences.es: El mono trepó al árbol con gran agilidad.
